chunks: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn 'Atiyya, from Sa'id al-A'raj, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:
Among the firmest bonds of faith is that you love for Allah, hate for Allah, give for Allah, and withhold for Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.أَوْثَق: Firmest, most trustworthy — superlative of وَثِيق (firm, reliable)
key_terms.تَمْنَعَ فِي اللَّه: To withhold for Allah's sake — refusing what God has forbidden
key_terms.تُبْغِضَ فِي اللَّه: To hate for Allah's sake — hating disobedience and those who persist in it
key_terms.تُحِبَّ فِي اللَّه: To love for Allah's sake — loving someone because of their obedience to God
key_terms.تُعْطِيَ فِي اللَّه: To give for Allah's sake — all generosity motivated by seeking divine pleasure
key_terms.عُرَى الْإِيمَان: Bonds/handles of faith — a metaphor for the elements that hold faith together, like the handles of a vessel

ai.seo_question: What are the firmest bonds of faith according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines one of the most robust pillars of true faith as performing all fundamental acts — loving, hating, giving, and withholding — purely for the sake of God, not personal preference or worldly gain. This principle, known as al-hubb fi Allah wa al-bughd fi Allah (love and hatred for God's sake), was a cornerstone of Shia ethical theology, emphasizing that one's entire social and emotional world must be oriented toward the divine. The original audience would have understood this as a direct challenge to tribal and clan loyalties that often overrode religious principles.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Malik b. Atiyya from Sa`id al-A`raj from Abi `Abdillah Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
From the firmest bonds of faith is to love for Allah, hate for Allah, give for Allah, and prevent for Allah.
